newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine H1 car sales down 7.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine H1 car sales down 7.8 percent.

text.p: Philippine car sales in the first six months of the year dropped 7.8 percent to 40,478 units against 43,879 in the year-ago period, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc said on Wednesday.
Car sales in June alone fell 16.7 percent to 6,566 units from last year's 7,884 units, it said in a report.
The group attributed the drop in Philippine car sales to "technical correction due to accelerated selling in 1996."

Toyota Motor Phils Inc, a unit of Toyota Motor Corp , sold the most units with 17,022 in the first six months of the year followed by Mitsubishi Motor Phils Corp, a unit of Mitsubishi Motors Corp, with 16,193.
